name: A Normal Walk Home.
source:
It's Halloween night and you're finally finishing up a long shift at the hospital! There's only a twenty minute walk between you and being able to sleep for the next couple days. Unfortunately, something or someone stops you in your path.

When face to face with a stranger claiming to be a vampire, would you rather leave them be or listen to what they have to say?

[From [url=https://nameless-entity.itch.io/a-normal-walk-home]Itch.io[/url]]
